settingsSaveFailed.message: Settings were not saved. Edit them or retry.

settingsLoadFailed.message: Settings could not be loaded. Retry before editing.

settingsExternalChanged.message: Settings updated from another page or sync.

settingsExternalConflict.message: External settings changed. Your unsaved edits are kept and take priority when saved.

operationBusy.message: OhMyTab: another operation is running. This request was not executed; try again after completion.

menuNotReady.message: OhMyTab: the menu was being prepared, so this request was not executed. Right-click and choose it again.

operationResult.message: OhMyTab: targets $1; completed $2; failed $3; unknown $4; API errors $5.

operationFailed.message: OhMyTab: operation stopped. Targets $1; completed $2; failed $3; unknown $4; API errors $5. Retry after checking the result.

protectDomainsHelp.message: Enter one site per line, such as example.com. Subdomains are also protected. Use site names, without URLs or *.

duplicateLast.message: Last tab in the current order (default)

duplicateActive.message: Prefer an active tab (otherwise the last tab)

previewHelp.message: Check the tabs before running. If tabs or settings change, or this confirmation expires, start the operation again.

previewBoundary.message: Pinned tabs and tabs in other private or container sessions are excluded. Canceling leaves tabs unchanged.

previewCancelled.message: Cancelled. Your tabs were not changed.

previewComplete.message: Operation finished. Check the extension icon for the result.

previewExpired.message: This preview is no longer available. Run the operation again.

previewStale.message: Tabs or settings changed. Nothing was executed. Run the operation again.

previewFailed.message: The operation failed or tabs changed while it was running. Check the extension icon for the result.

undoLimitations.message: Restore recorded web pages to their original windows. Form entries, browsing history and scroll positions cannot be restored. Some tabs, including private tabs, are not recorded.

undoRetention.message: Records cover the most recent eligible close operation: up to 50 tabs for up to 5 minutes. They may disappear earlier if the extension stops. You can delete them below.

undoUnknownHelp.message: If a restore result is unknown, check your open tabs before deleting the record. It cannot be retried, to avoid duplicates. If the original window is gone, tabs cannot be restored.

undoUnavailable.message: Records are unavailable in this session or the background has restarted.

ruleStorageHelp.message: Choose where to save URL rules. Using them on other devices depends on your browser’s sync settings. While switching, avoid editing rules on other devices: synced rules may be replaced or deleted.

ruleStorageUnavailable.message: You can view URL rules, but this browser cannot switch their storage.

ruleStorageResidual.message: Rules saved only in this browser are in use. URL rules remain in sync storage. Deleting them may also remove rules updated on other devices.

ruleStorageLocalReady.message: Using URL rules saved only in this browser.

ruleStorageSyncReady.message: URL rules are set to use browser sync.

ruleStorageCleanup.message: Delete URL rules left in sync storage

ruleStorageMoving.message: Saving edits and switching where URL rules are saved…

ruleStorageDraftPending.message: Save your edits before switching storage.

ruleStorageFailed.message: Could not finish switching storage or deleting rules. Your original rules are kept. Check the selected storage and any URL rules left in sync storage.

settingsTransferHelp.message: Display your saved settings, then copy them to keep a backup or paste them here on another browser. You can review changes before importing. Save any edits first.

settingsTransferSensitive.message: This data includes URL rules and protected site names. Check for private site information before sharing.

settingsJSONHelp.message: Paste settings data copied from OhMyTab. The supported format is ohmytab-settings version 1, UTF-8, up to 64 KiB. Edited or unsupported data may not import.

settingsImportMode.message: Review “current → imported” settings before applying. Canceling keeps your current settings. URL rule storage stays unchanged.

settingsImportFirefox.message: Tab grouping settings are not imported in Firefox.

settingsImportRecovery.message: The previous import did not finish. Select “Restore settings from before import” before saving, switching storage or importing again.

settingsTransferBusy.message: Wait for the current import or storage switch to finish.

settingsTransferDraft.message: Save your edits before displaying or importing settings. Your input is kept.

settingsExportReady.message: Copy and save all the data below.

settingsImportReviewReady.message: Review the values, then apply or cancel. Nothing has been imported yet.

settingsImportStale.message: The settings or input changed after review. Review the import again.

settingsImportDone.message: Settings imported. The storage location and unsupported preferences were retained.

settingsImportCancelled.message: Import cancelled. Stored settings were unchanged.

settingsImportRecovered.message: Original settings restored. You can save or import again.

globSyntaxHelp.message: Use *, **, ?, character classes such as [a-z], choices such as {docs,help}, and extglobs such as @(foo|bar), ?(foo), !(foo). Supported POSIX classes: alnum, alpha, ascii, blank, cntrl, digit, graph, lower, print, punct, space, upper, word, xdigit. Escape literal parentheses as \( and \); raw regular-expression parentheses are not supported.

globRepeatHelp.message: Repeated extglobs +(foo|bar) and *(a|b) allow only nonempty literal alternatives. Wildcards or nesting inside branches and overlapping prefixes such as +(a|aa) are rejected. Unclosed delimiters and unknown POSIX classes are errors.

globLimitsHelp.message: Use up to 100 rules. If they cannot be saved, reduce or shorten them.

globDisabledHelp.message: Turning off “Close tabs matching URLs” skips these rules. Other enabled actions still run. If a rule is invalid, correct it before running with URL rules enabled.

sessionBoundaryHelp.message: Operations stay within the same normal/private boundary as the requesting tab. Firefox also keeps the same container; requests with unknown session metadata are not executed. Pinned tabs are excluded.

protectionPolicyHelp.message: Actions skip protected tabs. Groups with a protected tab are not moved. Your selected setting determines which duplicate tab to keep.

previewOptionHelp.message: Check the target tabs before running. Tabs stay unchanged until you confirm.

workflowHelp.message: Save the workflow, then right-click a page and choose Workflow: name to run it.

workflowScopeHelp.message: To combine windows, select “All windows in the origin session.” Regular and private tabs stay separate. In Firefox, only tabs in the same container are included.

workflowRuleHelp.message: Tabs matching any enabled rule are included. Choose a site name, text in the URL or a wildcard pattern.

workflowDiscardHelp.message: Keep this draft, or discard it and continue?

workflowChooseOrigin.message: Choose an origin tab. Refresh and choose again if it moved or closed.

workflowProtections.message: Current protections and duplicate selection (applied when running)

workflowEmpty.message: No eligible targets. Check matches and protection exclusions.

workflowPreviewOpened.message: Confirmation opened. Review it before running. No draft was saved.

workflowError_invalid.message: Check the focused field. Combining windows requires all windows.

workflowError_conflict.message: Another options page saved changes, or your input changed while saving. Your edits are retained. Choose which version to use below.

workflowError_failed.message: The operation could not be completed. Your edits are retained. Try again.

workflowError_unavailable.message: Could not complete the operation. Please try again.

workflowError_busy.message: Another operation is running. Try again when it finishes.

workflowError_stale.message: Tabs or the workflow have changed. Start the operation again.

workflowError_unsupported.message: This operation is unsupported in this browser or session.

workflowGlueScope.message: Merge requires all windows. Choose all windows explicitly to continue.

workflowUseAll.message: Use all windows for this workflow

workflowScopeAll.message: All windows in the origin session

settingsFormatDetails.message: Settings data format and size limits

groupingHelp.message: Tabs from the same site are grouped at or above this count and ungrouped below it.

workflowConflictHelp.message: Using the saved version discards your current edits. Overwriting replaces changes saved in another options page.

workflowConflictChanged.message: Your input changed while checking. Nothing was saved. Review your current edits and choose again.

workflowConflictDeleted.message: This procedure was deleted in another options page. Your edits are retained, but the deleted procedure cannot be overwritten.

workflowSaveFailed.message: Saving could not be confirmed. Your edits are retained. Choose below to save again or use the saved version.

workflowConflictNewHelp.message: Other saved procedures changed. Save your current input as a new procedure, or discard it and reload the saved list.

urlRulesEnabledNotice.message: Global URL rules are enabled. Open Advanced features to review them.

workflowOriginAutomatic.message: Condition checks use an available tab in this window and browsing session automatically.

workflowOriginUnavailable.message: No eligible tab is available in this window and browsing session. Open a normal page here, then refresh the targets.

workflowStorageHelp.message: Workflows are saved only in this browser and are not included in settings backups.

workflowInspectionHelp.message: Choose an origin tab, then inspect. Results expire after 60 seconds. Current tab protections apply. Whole-workflow inspection does not run actions; save the workflow and use its context menu to run it.

workflowInspectionNoOrigin.message: No usable tab in this window and browsing session. Open options alongside an ordinary page in the same window and session, then reopen this dialog.

workflowInspectionUnsavedAck.message: Use this unsaved rule to proceed to confirmation

workflowInspectionClosePreview.message: Preview closing only this rule’s targets

workflowInspectionStale.message: Results are no longer current. Inspect again before proceeding.

workflowInspectionNotifyFailed.message: Could not invalidate the previous confirmation. Proceeding is disabled. Choose the origin again or reopen this dialog to retry.

workflowInspectionReady.message: Targets inspected. Closing requires a fresh preview and explicit confirmation.

workflowInspectionEmpty.message: No tabs to operate on. Inspect again after changing the conditions or tabs.

workflowInspectionConfirmHelp.message: A fresh preview is open. Confirm there to close tabs. Closing or changing this dialog invalidates that preview.

workflowInspectionDisabledRuleHelp.message: This rule is disabled in the workflow. This inspection and the single-rule close still use the selected rule.
